example.title: Kentucky 1013 Bridge, KY 1013 over Sand Lick Creek

brief: Pin-connected steel Pratt half-hip pony truss of 1893, one lane, on cut-stone abutments, still carrying a minor state route in a green valley: laced top chords, built-up verticals with lattice, eyebar diagonals, floor beams and stringers under a transverse-plank deck with running boards. A diamond-shaped cast builder's plate on the end post gives the maker and year; a WEIGHT LIMIT 10 TONS sign stands at the approach. (Span about 60 ft, estimated from photos.)
